content.comment_body: Hello, I hope you’re having a good day. I’m trying to configure an analog input with a range of 4-20mA in reverse, so that 4mA corresponds to 100 and 20mA to 0. How can I set this up in [product_name] using the ladder diagram, particularly for the [article_no] hardware version? If anyone has experience with this, please share your input. ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ Split from [company_name] Analog Reverse Calculation.

I’ve attached a basic example. Block B003 is only used as a placeholder and doesn’t affect the program—it helps complete blocks B001 and B002. Block B004 simply displays the current value from the analog input and doesn’t impact the calculation of the output value.

analysis.insight_summary: A user needs guidance on setting up a reversed analog input scale (4mA=100, 20mA=0) using a ladder diagram in [product_name] software for a specific [article_no] module.
